# Altitude Of

Source: [4561](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4561); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Altitude Of](../../api/values/altitude-of.md).
